hooks.command: ROOT="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; if [ -f "$ROOT/sovereign-omega-v2/.claude/hooks/session-hash-check.py" ]; then python3 "$ROOT/sovereign-omega-v2/.claude/hooks/session-hash-check.py"; elif [ -f "$ROOT/.claude/hooks/session-hash-check.py" ]; then python3 "$ROOT/.claude/hooks/session-hash-check.py"; else printf '%s\n' '{"systemMessage":"AEGIS frozen-file verification UNKNOWN: hash checker hook not found; protected mutations HOLD."}'; fi

ROOT="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; if ! git -C "$ROOT" rev-parse --show-toplevel >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '%s
' '{"systemMessage":"AEGIS worktree status UNKNOWN: not a Git checkout; do not infer clean state."}'; else if RAW=$(git -C "$ROOT" status --porcelain 2>/dev/null); then DIRTY=$(printf '%s
' "$RAW" | grep -v ' aegis-runtime/target/' || true); if [ -n "$DIRTY" ]; then COUNT=$(printf '%s
' "$DIRTY" | wc -l | tr -d ' '); printf '{"systemMessage":"AEGIS has %s uncommitted file(s). Preserve the work; do not auto-commit or push without authorization."}
' "$COUNT"; fi; else printf '%s
' '{"systemMessage":"AEGIS worktree status UNKNOWN: git status failed; no clean-state claim."}'; fi; fi

ROOT="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; if [ -f "$ROOT/sovereign-omega-v2/.claude/hooks/frozen-write-guard.py" ]; then python3 "$ROOT/sovereign-omega-v2/.claude/hooks/frozen-write-guard.py"; elif [ -f "$ROOT/.claude/hooks/frozen-write-guard.py" ]; then python3 "$ROOT/.claude/hooks/frozen-write-guard.py"; else printf '%s\n' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"AEGIS frozen guard missing; fail closed"}}'; fi

ROOT="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; if [ -f "$ROOT/scripts/claude-authority-guard.py" ]; then python3 "$ROOT/scripts/claude-authority-guard.py"; elif [ -f "$ROOT/../scripts/claude-authority-guard.py" ]; then python3 "$ROOT/../scripts/claude-authority-guard.py"; else printf '%s\n' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"AEGIS authority guard missing; fail closed"}}'; fi

ROOT="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; if [ -f "$ROOT/sovereign-omega-v2/.claude/hooks/tier-check.sh" ]; then bash "$ROOT/sovereign-omega-v2/.claude/hooks/tier-check.sh"; elif [ -f "$ROOT/.claude/hooks/tier-check.sh" ]; then bash "$ROOT/.claude/hooks/tier-check.sh"; else printf '%s\n' 'AEGIS tier-check UNKNOWN: hook file not found'; fi
hooks.statusMessage: AEGIS read-only source tier warning (Write and Edit)

hooks.command: msg=$(cat 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.notification // empty' 2>/dev/null); if echo "$msg" | grep -q 'FROZEN FILE VIOLATION\|HASH VIOLATION'; then echo "{\"systemMessage\": \"⛔ CONSTITUTIONAL BREACH DETECTED — $msg — invoke guardian agent immediately\"}"; elif echo "$msg" | grep -q 'UNCOMMITTED SRC'; then echo "{\"systemMessage\": \"⚠ $msg — run Gate 8 and commit before continuing\"}"; fi
